title: [3.0-dev] Unable to enter carbs in main screen
body:
After a night of looping with 3.0 I wanted to enter carbs in the morning - but any press on the "+" button just resets the field to empty. MaxCarbs was set to 90 during clean app setup last night.
adb log contains lines like
`10-19 09:21:12.711 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
10-19 09:21:12.770   770   840 E SDM     : HWCDisplay::GetHWCLayer: [0] GetLayer(82149) failed: no such layer
10-19 09:21:12.772   839   839 W HwcComposer: command 0x3000000 generated error 3
10-19 09:21:12.890 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
10-19 09:21:12.968  3399  8089 W NotificationService: Toast already killed. pkg=info.nightscout.androidaps token=android.os.BinderProxy@53dd8dd
10-19 09:21:13.091 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
10-19 09:21:13.121   770   840 E SDM     : HWCDisplay::GetHWCLayer: [0] GetLayer(82151) failed: no such layer
10-19 09:21:13.123   839   839 W HwcComposer: command 0x3000000 generated error 3
10-19 09:21:13.259 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
10-19 09:21:13.425 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
10-19 09:21:13.472   770   840 E SDM     : HWCDisplay::GetHWCLayer: [0] GetLayer(82154) failed: no such layer
10-19 09:21:13.474   839   839 W HwcComposer: command 0x3000000 generated error 3
10-19 09:21:13.610 32380 32380 D CONSTRAINTS: [main]: [Constraint.setIfSmaller():47]: Setting because of smaller value 1111111 -> 0 (Begrenze Kohlenhydrate auf 0 g wegen Max. Wert in den Einstellungen)[Safety]
`
So apparently carbs are now limited to 0? Settings still confirm "Max. erlaubte Kohlenhydrate [g]" to be 90,0.
Editing the value and re-setting it to "90" fixed the issue.

My guess: The setup-wizzard stored the value as "90,0" - mind the "," - and this can't be parsed afterwards (as it would like to have a ".") leading to a limit of "0".

comments.body:
Only integer values works, decimal values for carbs maximum values are not accepted ( , or . separator...)...
I'll take a look if I can fix it...
I certainly did not enter it specifically as "90,0" in the setup wizard - not sure if it was a scrolling thing or if I entered "90" as numbers.
